items: 【Lightweight Red Cordless Drill】The 8V drill set can be used for drilling in wood and plastic, and tightening/loosening screws.Press the switch to adjust the speed of the electric drill, the maximum no-load speed of the mini drill is 800r/min. The net weight of the hand drill is only 1.65 pounds, and it is easy to operate with one hand.

【Rechargeable Battery】This red drill is supplied with a type-C 1.5A charging cable.A universal charger or USB output(5Vd.c) can charge the small drill.The battery indicator light is at the back of the drill.
【Be a Handy Women】This cordless drill combo kit are made of alloy steel, chrome plated to prevent corrosion, grip is anti-skid and comfortable.It is a good tool sets for women to do general DIY.

【Multi-functional Tool Kit with Drill】This Red tool set contains the most practical and advanced tools for design, repair or maintenance. This red tool box is perfect for decoration, furniture assembly, drilling, cutting, gardening, office or daily home maintenance.

【Package Included】8V Cordless Drill, hex nut screwdriver, Screwdriver, precision Screwdriver, twisted drills, hex key, magneitc bits holder, 50L bits, 25I bits, 1/4" sockets, Measure Tape Ruler, fasteners, claw hammer, adjustable wrench, Utility Knife Blade, Utility knife, Long Nose Pilers, User Manual.
